Acme Model X100

Specifications

The Model X100 is built for continuous-duty packaging lines. Rated for 12,000 cycles per hour with sealed bearings and IP65 ingress protection. Compatible with Acme QuickSwap mounts across the X-series frame family.

Pricing

Starting at $249 for the base configuration. Volume discounts available above fifty units. Contact sales for configured BOM pricing.
